title: suggest-prelude-action output data
description:
The ONE next prelude step, its ``why``, and the call to make.

A TOTAL ladder: every state of the five substrates maps to exactly one
``action``. ``rung`` is the priority the match came from (0 = a corrupt /
unreadable substrate, which is always disclosed rather than crashed on; the
last rung is the catch-all "the prelude is settled"). ``substrates`` is the
evidence vector the decision was made over.

rung.description: The priority tier that matched — lower fires first. The ladder is total, so a rung always resolves (no escalation).
rung.title: Rung

action.description: The single next prelude step to take.
action.title: Action

why.description: One line naming the substrate fact this action follows from.
why.title: Why

scaffold.description: The exact call the action is made with.

findings.description: Every named substrate observation, including the ones a lower rung pre-empted — so nothing read is silently dropped.
findings.title: Findings

disclosures.description: Honest notes about what could not be determined (a source the parser refused, a run the AST scan did not find, additional audits not reported). Advisory; never blocks.
disclosures.title: Disclosures

substrates.description: The disclosed evidence vector the ladder decided over.

PreludeFinding.description:
One named substrate observation — the evidence a rung fired on.

A finding is never a judgement: ``substrate`` names WHICH of the five was
read, ``detail`` states the mechanical fact, and ``remedy`` (when there is a
named one) states the repair in the repo's own vocabulary — e.g. the
2026-07-30 live fumble, "bound but not opted in — add the packs entry".

substrate.description: Which of the five prelude substrates this observation came from.
substrate.title: Substrate

detail.description: The mechanical fact observed (never an interpretation).
detail.title: Detail

remedy.description: The named repair, when the finding has one (e.g. 'bound but not opted in — add the packs entry'). Null for a finding that is only disclosure.
remedy.title: Remedy

PreludeFinding.title: prelude substrate finding

PreludeScaffold.description:
The exact call the suggested action is made with.

Either a VERB invocation (``cli`` carries the exact command line, ``spec``
the ``--spec`` skeleton) or a FILE EDIT (``verb`` names the file, ``cli`` is
null and ``spec`` carries the JSON fragment to add) — the pack opt-in remedy
is the latter. ``unresolved_fields`` flags the placeholder paths the caller
must fill, the ``scaffold-spec`` convention.

verb.description: The target verb to invoke, or the file to edit (e.g. `interview.json`) when the remedy is not a verb call.
verb.title: Verb

cli.description: The exact CLI invocation, with every derivable value filled. Null when the remedy is a file edit rather than a verb call.
cli.title: Cli

spec.description: The `--spec` skeleton for the target verb, or the JSON fragment to add to the named file. Null when the verb takes no spec.
spec.title: Spec

unresolved_fields.description: Dotted paths inside `spec` whose values are PLACEHOLDERS the ladder could not derive from a durable record — the caller fills them before invoking (never guessed).
unresolved_fields.title: Unresolved Fields

PreludeScaffold.title: prelude action scaffold

PreludeSubstrates.description:
The disclosed evidence vector the ladder decided over.

Every field is presence, a count, or an identity list over opaque content —
published so a caller can see WHY a rung fired without re-reading the five
substrates itself.

audit_ids.description: Every audit_id with a notebook decision journal on disk, sorted.
audit_ids.title: Audit Ids

audit_id.description: The audit the ladder is reporting on (the first, sorted, that a notebook rung fired for), or null when no notebook rung fired.
audit_id.title: Audit Id

audit_config_recorded.description: True when the reported audit has a config seat — either interview.json's `audited_source` block or a journaled `notebook-audit-config` record.
audit_config_recorded.title: Audit Config Recorded

audited_source_seat.description: True when interview.json's `audited_source` block names the reported audit's source + template (the only durable seat that does).
audited_source_seat.title: Audited Source Seat

notebook_passed.description: notebook-status's `passed` predicate for the reported audit, recomputed through the SAME reduction (never a second definition). Null when the source/template are not resolvable from a durable seat.
notebook_passed.title: Notebook Passed

sections_awaiting.description: How many REQUIRED sections are not current (awaiting sign-off) for the reported audit. Null when `notebook_passed` is null.
sections_awaiting.title: Sections Awaiting

packs_opted_in.description: Pack names carried by interview.json's `packs` opt-in block, sorted.
packs_opted_in.title: Packs Opted In

packs_bound.description: Pack names with a CURRENT bind on their pack journal, sorted.
packs_bound.title: Packs Bound

interview_json.description: Whether an `interview.json` exists at either probed location.
interview_json.title: Interview Json

materialized.description: Whether an interview.json carries a `_materialized` block.
materialized.title: Materialized

entry_point_run_name.description: The materialized entry point's `run_name`, when one was recorded — the key the axes.yaml `executors` staleness check is made against.
entry_point_run_name.title: Entry Point Run Name

PreludeSubstrates.title: prelude substrate evidence
